name: Strict Mode
description: Introduces a restricted variant of JavaScript that eliminates silent errors by throwing exceptions, disables features that are confusing or poorly thought out, and simplifies variable resolution (e.g., forbidding implicit global creation).

name: Array Iteration Methods
description: Adds functional programming methods directly to the Array prototype for traversing, mapping, filtering, and reducing arrays, along with the static `Array.isArray()` method to reliably differentiate arrays from other objects.

name: Date.now() and Date ISO/JSON Formatting
description: Introduces `Date.now()` to get the current timestamp in milliseconds without instantiating a Date object, along with standard `.toISOString()` and `.toJSON()` serialization methods.

name: Function.prototype.bind
description: Creates a new function that, when called, has its `this` keyword set to the provided value, with a given sequence of arguments preceding any provided when the new function is called.

name: Native JSON Parsing and Serialization
description: Standardizes a built-in `JSON` object for parsing JSON text strings into JavaScript objects and serializing values into JSON formatted strings without relying on `eval()`.

name: Object Literal Getters and Setters
description: Introduces syntax for binding an object property to a function that will be invoked when that property is looked up (`get`) or assigned to (`set`).

name: Property Descriptors and Object Reflection
description: Enables precise control over object property attributes (`configurable`, `enumerable`, `writable`, `value`) via descriptors. Also adds object meta-operations like `Object.keys()`, `Object.create()`, and immutability controls (`freeze`, `seal`).

name: String Property Access
description: Standardizes character access via square bracket notation (str[index]) as an alternative to charAt(index).

name: String.prototype.trim
description: Strips leading and trailing whitespace from strings.

name: Built-in Collections: Map, Set, WeakMap, and WeakSet
description: New collection types: Map (key-value pairs with arbitrary key types), Set (unique values), WeakMap (key-value pairs with weakly-held object keys), and WeakSet (weakly-held unique objects).

name: const Declarations
description: Block-scoped read-only constant declaration.

name: Iterators and for...of Statement
description: Protocol for iterable objects (implementing `Symbol.iterator`) and the `for...of` loop to traverse iterable elements.

name: Promise Objects
description: A built-in object representing the eventual completion (or failure) of an asynchronous operation and its resulting value.

name: Binary and Octal Numeric Literals
description: Direct syntax for binary literals (`0b` or `0B` prefix) and octal literals (`0o` or `0O` prefix).

name: Enhanced Built-in Methods
description: Numerous method additions across Object (`Object.assign`, `Object.is`), Array (`Array.from`, `Array.of`, `find`, `findIndex`), String (`includes`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `repeat`), Number (`Number.isNaN`, `Number.isInteger`), and Math (`Math.trunc`, `Math.sign`).

name: Symbol Primitive Type
description: A unique and immutable primitive value that can be used as the key of an object property to avoid naming collisions. Also introduces well-known symbols like `Symbol.iterator` and `Symbol.toStringTag`.

name: Template Literals and Tagged Templates
description: Multi-line string literals allowing embedded expressions via `${expression}` syntax, and tagged template functions that allow custom parsing and formatting of template literals.

name: Enhanced Object Literals
description: Syntactic enhancements for object initializers including property value shorthand, method definition shorthand, and computed property names.

name: Destructuring Assignment
description: Syntax allowing extraction of values from arrays or properties from objects into distinct variables, supporting default fallback values and nested destructuring.

name: Array.prototype.includes
description: Determines whether an array includes a certain value among its entries, returning true or false. Unlike `indexOf() !== -1`, `includes()` correctly compares `NaN` values using SameValueZero equality.

name: Arrow Function Definitions
description: Provides a concise syntax for anonymous functions using the `=>` token. Arrow functions lexically bind `this`, `arguments`, `super`, and `new.target` from their enclosing scope rather than defining their own.

name: Default Parameter Values, Rest Parameters, and Spread Syntax
description: Allows formal parameters to be initialized with default values if no value or `undefined` is passed. Rest parameters (`...rest`) collect remaining arguments into an array. Spread syntax (`...iterable`) expands iterables.

name: Generator Functions and yield Statement
description: Functions defined with `function*` that can be paused and resumed using the `yield` keyword, returning a Generator object that conforms to both the iterable and iterator protocols.

name: let Declarations
description: Block-scoped variable declaration. Resides in the Temporal Dead Zone until evaluation.

name: Proxy and Reflect Objects
description: `Proxy` allows intercepting and defining custom behavior for fundamental object operations (property lookup, assignment, enumeration, etc.). `Reflect` provides built-in static methods for interceptable JavaScript operations, mirroring Proxy traps.

name: Iterator Helpers
description: Extends iterator objects with functional programming methods similar to Array prototype methods, enabling lazy, memory-efficient processing of potentially infinite sequences without intermediate array allocations.

name: Class Definitions and Inheritance
description: Introduces class syntax as syntactic sugar over prototype-based inheritance, including constructors, instance methods, static methods, and `extends`/`super` for subclassing.

name: Exponentiation Operator
description: An infix operator for exponentiation, providing a cleaner shorthand for `Math.pow(base, exponent)`.

name: Object.entries
description: Returns an array of a given object's own enumerable string-keyed property [key, value] pairs.

name: Object.values
description: Returns an array of a given object's own enumerable string-keyed property values.

name: Async Functions
description: Provides syntactic sugar over Promises, allowing asynchronous operations to be written in a synchronous, procedural style. Functions marked with `async` implicitly return a Promise, and `await` pauses execution until the Promise settles.

name: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors
description: Returns all own property descriptors of a given object, enabling accurate cloning of objects including getters, setters, and non-enumerable properties without losing their attributes.

name: String.prototype.padEnd
description: Pads the current string from the end with another string until the target length is reached.

name: String.prototype.padStart
description: Pads the current string from the start with another string until the target length is reached.

name: Trailing Commas in Function Parameter Lists and Calls
description: Allows trailing commas in function definitions and function calls, making git diffs cleaner when adding new parameters.

name: ES Modules
description: Native syntax for modular programming using `export` and `import` declarations. Note: Since this entire file is an ES module using `export`, this feature is natively exemplified by the module structure itself.

name: Promise.prototype.finally
description: Registers a callback to be invoked when a Promise settles (either fulfilled or rejected), enabling cleanup operations without having to duplicate callbacks in both `.then()` and `.catch()`.

name: Asynchronous Iteration and Async Generators
description: Introduces `async function*` for generating asynchronous sequences of data, and the `for await...of` loop to iterate over async iterables (objects implementing `Symbol.asyncIterator`).

name: Rest and Spread Properties for Objects
description: Extends the rest/spread syntax (`...`) to object literals. Rest properties collect remaining own enumerable properties into a new object during destructuring. Spread properties copy own enumerable properties into an object literal.

name: Template Literal Revision
description: Lifts restrictions on syntactic escape sequences within tagged template literals. Invalid escape sequences (e.g., `\unicode`) result in `undefined` for string representation in `strings`, while `strings.raw` retains the raw text.

name: Array.prototype.flat
description: Creates a new array with all sub-array elements concatenated into it recursively up to the specified depth.

name: Array.prototype.flatMap
description: Maps each element using a mapping function, then flattens the result into a new array by depth 1.

name: Object.fromEntries
description: Transforms a list of key-value pairs (such as a Map or an array of `[key, value]` arrays) into an object. Acts as the inverse of `Object.entries()`.

name: Optional Catch Binding
description: Allows omitting the exception binding variable in `catch` blocks when the thrown error object is not needed.

name: Stable Array.prototype.sort
description: Mandates that `Array.prototype.sort()` be stable, ensuring that array elements comparing equal retain their original order.

name: String.prototype.trimEnd
description: Removes whitespace from the end of a string.

name: String.prototype.trimStart
description: Removes whitespace from the beginning (start) of a string.

name: Symbol.prototype.description
description: A read-only property returning the optional string description specified when creating a Symbol object, directly without requiring `.toString()` conversion.

name: Well-Formed JSON.stringify
description: Prevents `JSON.stringify` from returning ill-formed UTF-16 strings when encountering lone surrogate code points (U+D800 to U+DFFF), representing them instead as JSON escape sequences (e.g., `\ud800`).

name: Dynamic Import (import())
description: Function-like syntax allowing asynchronous, on-demand module loading at runtime, returning a Promise that resolves to the module namespace object.

name: globalThis
description: Provides a universal standard mechanism to access the global `this` value across different JavaScript environments (e.g., `window` in browser, `global` in Node.js, `self` in Web Workers).

name: import.meta Meta-Property
description: An object exposing context-specific metadata to a JavaScript module, such as the URL of the current module (`import.meta.url`).

name: String.prototype.matchAll
description: Returns an iterator of all results matching a string against a regular expression (which must have the `g` flag), including capturing groups for each match.

name: Hashbang Grammar
description: Standardizes syntax stripping for executable scripts starting with `#!` (hashbang/shebang) on the very first line of a source file, allowing JavaScript files to run directly in Unix-like CLI environments without syntax errors. Note: Notice the `#!/usr/bin/env node` at line 1 of this file demonstrating this syntax!

name: RegExp Named Capture Groups
description: Allows capturing groups in regular expressions to be assigned explicit names via `(?<name>...)`, which can then be accessed on the `groups` property of the match object.

name: RegExp s (dotAll) Flag
description: Introduces the `s` flag for regular expressions, which alters the dot (`.`) metacharacter to match any character, including line terminators (like `\n` and `\r`).

name: RegExp Unicode Property Escapes
description: Enables matching characters based on Unicode character properties inside regular expressions using `\p{...}` and `\P{...}` when the `u` flag is enabled.

name: Nullish Coalescing Operator
description: A logical operator returning its right-hand operand when its left-hand operand is `null` or `undefined`, and otherwise returning its left-hand operand. Avoids overriding valid falsy values like `0` or `""`.

name: Optional Chaining Operator
description: Allows reading the value of a property located deep within a chain of connected objects without having to expressly validate that each reference in the chain is valid. If a reference is nullish, expression short-circuits to `undefined`.

name: Promise.allSettled
description: Returns a promise that resolves after all of the given promises have either fulfilled or rejected, with an array of objects describing the outcome (`status: "fulfilled" | "rejected"`) of each promise.

name: Numeric Separators
description: Allows underscores (`_`) as visual separators within numeric literals (decimal, binary, hex, octal, BigInt) to enhance readability of large numbers without affecting programmatic values.

name: String.prototype.replaceAll
description: Returns a new string with all matches of a pattern (either a string or a RegExp with `g` flag) replaced by a replacement. Eliminates the need for regular expressions when replacing literal string occurrences globally.

name: BigInt Arbitrary-Precision Integers
description: Introduces a new numeric primitive type `BigInt` for representing integers of arbitrary magnitude, bypassing Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER limitations. Created via `n` suffix or `BigInt()` function.

name: Logical Assignment Operators
description: Combines logical operations with assignment. The assignment only occurs if the logical condition evaluates to trigger evaluation of the right-hand side (short-circuiting assignment).

name: Promise.any() and AggregateError
description: `Promise.any()` takes an iterable of Promise objects and resolves as soon as any of the promises fulfills. If all of the given promises are rejected, it rejects with an `AggregateError` grouping all individual errors.

name: WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry
description: `WeakRef` holds a weak reference to an object, allowing it to be garbage collected without preventing reclamation. `FinalizationRegistry` provides a way to register custom cleanup callbacks to be invoked after an object is garbage collected.

name: Error Cause
description: Allows specifying an underlying error cause via the `{ cause: err }` options object passed to Error constructors, aiding error chaining and debugging across async architectural layers.

name: Private Field Check Syntax
description: Allows checking whether a specific private field or method is present on an object using the `in` operator, without throwing a TypeError when checking arbitrary objects.

name: RegExp Match Indices
description: Introduces the `/.../d` regex flag, which instructs regex execution methods (`exec`, `matchAll`) to include an `indices` array property on the match object detailing the start and end character positions of each matched group.

name: Shared Memory and Atomics
description: Introduces `SharedArrayBuffer` for sharing memory across worker threads, and the `Atomics` namespace object providing atomic operations (load, store, add, sub, exchange, wait, notify) for predictable thread synchronization.

name: .at() Method on Indexable Objects
description: Takes an integer value and returns the item at that index, allowing positive integers for indexing from the start and negative integers for relative indexing from the end (e.g., `-1` for the last element).

name: Object.hasOwn
description: A static method that returns true if the specified object has the indicated property as its own property. Serves as a safer, more concise alternative to `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, prop)`.

name: Array.prototype.findLast
description: Iterates through an array in reverse order to find the value of the first element satisfying the predicate.

name: Array.prototype.findLastIndex
description: Iterates through an array in reverse order to find the index of the first element satisfying the predicate.

name: Class Fields
description: Extends classes with declarative instance and static fields without requiring constructor initialization, along with truly private members (fields and methods) prefixed with `#` that cannot be accessed outside the class body.

name: RegExp Lookbehind Assertions
description: Enables positive `(?<=...)` and negative `(?<!...)` lookbehind assertions, matching a pattern only if it is (or is not) preceded by a specific assertion.

name: Class Static Initialization Blocks
description: Introduces `static { ... }` blocks within class bodies to evaluate complex static initialization logic with access to private static/instance fields of the class.

name: Change by Copy Methods
description: Introduces non-mutating equivalents to traditional Array/TypedArray mutators. Instead of modifying the array in place, these methods return a new array copy with the transformations applied.

name: Function.prototype.toString() Revision
description: Requires `Function.prototype.toString()` to return the exact source code text slice used to define the function, preserving whitespace, comments, and syntax.

name: RegExp v Flag
description: An upgrade over the `u` flag (`/pattern/v`) that enables set notation and operations within character classes, supporting string properties, difference (`--`), and intersection (`&&`) of Unicode sets.

name: String Well-Formedness
description: `.isWellFormed()` checks whether a string contains lone surrogate code points (which would make it ill-formed UTF-16). `.toWellFormed()` returns a new string where any lone surrogates are replaced with the Unicode replacement character U+FFFD.

name: Map.groupBy
description: Groups elements of an iterable according to arbitrary keys returned by a callback function into a Map.

name: Object.groupBy
description: Groups elements of an iterable according to string/symbol keys returned by a callback function.

name: Promise.withResolvers
description: A static method returning an object containing a new Promise along with its associated `resolve` and `reject` functions, avoiding the boilerplate of extracting resolvers from within a `new Promise(...)` executor constructor callback.

name: New Set Methods
description: Standardizes mathematical set operations natively on `Set` instances, returning new Set objects with the computed results or boolean values for subset/superset/disjoint comparisons.

name: Resizable and Transferable ArrayBuffers
description: Introduces `maxByteLength` option for creating resizable ArrayBuffers, along with `.resize()` to change size in place and `.transfer()` to detach buffer ownership and move memory to a new ArrayBuffer without copying when possible.

name: RegExp Duplicate Named Capture Groups
description: Allows multiple capture groups in different alternatives of a regular expression (separated by `|`) to share the exact same group name (`(?<name>...)`), simplifying pattern matching across mutually exclusive branch formats.

name: Promise.try
description: Wraps synchronous or asynchronous function execution inside a Promise, ensuring that any exceptions thrown synchronously are caught and converted into a rejected Promise rather than terminating execution synchronously.

name: Atomics.pause
description: A micro-architectural CPU instruction hint for spinlocks and busy-waiting loops in multithreaded environments. Signals to the processor that the thread is in a spin-wait loop, reducing power consumption and memory bus contention.

name: Float16Array and Math.f16round
description: Introduces 16-bit half-precision floating point number support via `Float16Array` typed arrays and `Math.f16round()` rounding method, optimizing memory footprint and GPU interoperability for machine learning and graphics workflows.

name: Import Attributes
description: Provides inline syntax for specifying module import assertions/attributes using the `with` keyword, informing runtime module loaders how to interpret loaded resources (e.g., verifying a file is parsed as JSON rather than executed as code).

name: RegExp.escape
description: A static method that escapes special regular expression syntax characters within a string, allowing user-supplied literal text to be safely incorporated into dynamically constructed regular expressions without regex injection risks.

name: Uint8Array Base64 and Hexadecimal Encoding/Decoding
description: Standardizes native conversion methods on `Uint8Array` for encoding byte buffers to hexadecimal (`toHex`) and Base64 (`toBase64`) strings, as well as static constructors (`fromHex`, `fromBase64`) for parsing text strings back into byte arrays.

name: Atomics.waitAsync
description: Asynchronous version of `Atomics.wait()`, returning a Promise that resolves when a shared memory location is notified or times out. Non-blocking, making it safe for use on the main browser UI thread where synchronous `Atomics.wait()` is disallowed.

name: Symbols as WeakMap and WeakSet Keys
description: Expands `WeakMap` keys and `WeakSet` values to allow non-registered Symbol primitives (symbols created with `Symbol()` rather than `Symbol.for()`) in addition to object references, since non-registered symbols have unique identities.

name: Math.sumPrecise
description: Computes the exact floating-point sum of an iterable of numbers without losing precision from intermediate floating-point rounding errors, implementing compensated summation techniques.

name: Top-Level Await
description: Enables the use of `await` directly at the top level of an ES module outside of any async function, pausing module evaluation and dependency graph resolution until the awaited Promise settles.

name: Error.isError
description: A static method that reliably detects whether a value is an Error instance (including built-in errors, custom subclasses, and DOMException objects), working across different realms (iframes, worker threads, VM contexts) where `instanceof Error` fails.
